news.title: Amazon and Intel Q3 earnings fuel a broad tech rout into the open
news.text: Amazon and Intel both reported Q3 2026 results after Thursday's close; both are sliding premarket and dragging the Nasdaq down roughly 2-2.5% while the S&P 500 is off about 1.2% and the Dow roughly flat to slightly down, per live market blogs just ahead of the open. Many of today's watchlist movers (PLTR, SNAP, NTAP, CIEN, AAOI, FFIV) are down in sympathy with the broader tech/AI-sentiment pullback rather than on their own news.
